optimizedDescription.value: Defines deterministic stateless adapters for full-file analysis, resolution manifests, semantic facts, relations, and human references.

optimizedContext.value:
# language-adapter

## Rules
- Stateless `LanguageAdapter` interface, synchronous/deterministic:
  - `languages(): string[]`
  - `extensions(): Record<string, string>`
  - `resolutionManifests(): readonly string[]`
  - `analyzeFile(filePath, content, context): FileAnalysisDraft`
  - `resolveImports(analysis, context): ResolvedImports`
  - `buildRelations(analysis, context): readonly Relation[]`
  - optional `getPackageIdentity`, `resolvePackageFromSpecifier`, `resolveQualifiedNameToPath`.
- `resolutionManifests()` returns exact manifest basenames, no globs/paths/I/O. TypeScript returns `package.json`; built-ins declare every manifest actually read.
- One `analyzeFile` emits complete serializable compact facts: symbols, imports, bindings, calls, namespaces, source ranges, optional compact parser state. Never retain AST/parser trees or parallel legacy extraction.
- Registry dynamically maps adapters/languages/extensions via `register`, `getAdapter`, `getAdapterForFile`, `getLanguageForFile`, `getAdapters`; TypeScript default; unknown extension silently skipped.
- Import facts contain `localName`, `originalName`, `specifier`, `isRelative`; syntax parsed in analysis, targets resolved Pass 2. TS/Python relative starts `.`; Go/PHP never relative.
- Call caller is innermost function/method/arrow; deterministic local/import/receiver candidates only. Drop top-level, unresolved, ambiguous, dynamic calls.
- Extract scoped facts for lexical ownership, typed parameters/properties, construction, deterministic receivers/aliases/types/framework bindings. Common pipeline owns lookup/shadowing/candidate filtering. Drop runtime reflection, containers, monkey patching, dynamic expressions, interprocedural aliases.
- Built-in TS/JS, Python, Go, PHP implement common analysis/resolution/relation/reference/range/coverage/capability contract; adapter-specific specs own language semantics. Generic pipeline has no language-name compensating branches.
- Emit resolvable `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; `DEPENDS_ON` reserved for specs. Unsupported or ambiguous static evidence is dropped or explicit unsupported coverage, never guessed.
- Package identity walks from `codeRoot` toward bounded `repoRoot`: TS `package.json.name`; Python `[project].name` only; Go `go.mod module`; PHP `composer.json.name`. CLI/MCP obtains repo root from `VcsAdapter.rootDir()`. Import resolution uses `IndexSession`, not symbol scans or Pass-2 filesystem probing.
- Each adapter truthfully declares capabilities for declarations, members, public/local bindings, hierarchy, build-context selection. Facts use shared logical-symbol, binding, symbol-space, `MemberSemantics`, range, hierarchy, provenance, coverage vocabulary.
- Member-capable adapters derive logical declaring owner from syntax; never parser IDs. Emit `MemberSemantics` (`kind`, `dispatch`, `accessor`, optional `nativeKind`), never retired member form. Declaration occurrence with owner gets `parentId`; top-level omits it. Same-name members under different owners stay distinct.
- Parse supported human/native member references into zero/one/many explicit owner-then-member selectors; render generic and optional native spellings. Dynamic/ambiguous remains unresolved. Never parse canonical/structured requests as human text or split `.` in shared domain.
- Re-exports: adapter resolves each specifier and emits public binding/provenance. Relative → importing-workspace file; package → language package identity/public entry map. TypeScript honors `name`, `exports`, `main`, `.js`→indexed source. Binding `surface` is re-exporting file; `targetId` is entry-published logical ID, including cross-workspace. Non-unique entry produces no guess. Indexer only persists; never interprets manifests/routes or copies bindings.
- `hierarchy:true` requires shared hierarchy facts and ordered provenance sufficient for child→ancestor/embedded/composed/contract owner then member lookup, consistent with persisted hierarchy relations. Supported resolvable syntax cannot emit empty evidence; unsupported precedence/build alternatives become unsupported/unresolved.
- Every symbol has parser-derived complete construct range plus contained exact-name `selectionRange`, half-open. Omit untrustworthy candidate and report capability gap; never approximate via next symbol/line regex.
- `getPackageIdentity` and optional `resolveQualifiedNameToPath` alone may perform I/O; qualified-name metadata must be prepared/cached before Pass 2 candidate resolution.

## Constraints
- Interface, not abstract class; no `@specd/core` dependency.
- Analysis/cache state compact plain data; no parser retention.
- All resolution synchronous/deterministic; Pass 2 no per-candidate filesystem probes.
- Indexer contains no language-specific resolution.
- Unrecognized, unresolved, dynamic, fuzzy, runtime-only facts silently dropped unless explicit unsupported coverage required.
- Tree-sitter queries internal implementation details.
